what: Forward FREEZE — sealed governance prediction over the live listed universe.

window.note: half-open [start, end_exclusive) — complete IST days only; the in-progress freeze day is excluded

universe_definition: symbols with >=1 filing in the window (excl. already-in-CIRP); NOT every listed name — the +12m base-rate denominator must be computed over this same population
score_formula: equal-weight binary presence of the 4 flags (0..4); no fitted weights; no threshold tuning
limits: pledge + RPT are NOT in the automated score (PDF-locked / listed-only) — this is the ~4-flag headline score
~2yr filing depth caps this at a ~12-month-lead "end-of-cycle" monitor, not a 24-month leading indicator
moat caveat: these flags are SEBI Reg-30 24h disclosures — a positive result proves signal exists, not edge

evaluation_rule_preregistered.how: pull NEW IBBI/NCLT admissions + first-default/rating-D events in (freeze_date, +12m] from PUBLIC sources; compute the fraction of the top-5% flagged list that hit an event vs the universe base rate
evaluation_rule_preregistered.build_signal: lift >= 3x base rate with flags dated before the distress event
evaluation_rule_preregistered.note: decided now, before the outcome exists; do not move after seeing 2027 data

git_commit: FILL AFTER COMMIT (the commit hash + timestamp is the seal)
reproducibility: Authoritative seal = the committed git blob. Verify via `git show <commit>:<path> | sha256sum`, NOT a working-copy re-hash (core.autocrlf can rewrite line endings — a .gitattributes keeps these files -text) and NOT a re-run (reproduces the hash only if no past-day rows were backfilled between runs).
